title: Sharks Rubber Chicken addon
description: A mod that is all about RUBBER CHICKENS. It adds 1 new item, 2 new tools, and 1 new mob
body:
# 🐔 Rubber Chicken Mod – Forge 1.20.1

**Squawk like you mean it!**  
This ridiculous but awesome mod brings a full *rubber chicken-themed* experience to Minecraft — complete with custom tools, pets, and sounds.

---

## 🧩 Features

- ⚔️ **Rubber Chicken Sword & Pickaxe**  
  Meme-tier weapons with absurd squeaky power. Craftable with custom items.

- 💩 **"Chicken Rubber" Drops**  
  Defeated Rubber Chickens will leave behind valuable, flexible loot.

- 🧠 **Custom Advancements**  
  Unlock squawk-worthy achievements just by playing.

---

## 💬 Final Notes

This is a **meme mod with real effort** behind it — perfect for chaotic modpacks, chicken cults, or just annoying your friends.

Have ideas for more squeaky features? Want a boss chicken? Reach out!

---
